title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nginx:1.24 security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for nginx version 1.24 addressing two vulnerabilities in the ngx_http_core_module. The first is a heap-based buffer overflow triggered via alias with rewrite referencing $request_filename (CVE-2026-15176). The second is another unspecified vulnerability in the same module (CVE-2026-97205). These issues affect Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support and related variants. The advisory rates the update as important and provides updated packages to remediate the vulnerabilities.
